text: Round-2 hotfixes applied after the prior critic rejection: overview coefficient labels are reader-facing and tiny p-values use format.pval rather than literal zero; contrast heatmap labels come from category/attention levels; multisubject handoff uses fmrireg::group_data(format="csv") with an explicit contrast column and no deprecated API.
